privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.summaryBody: your smoking data is kept in a secure cache on your device and synced with our Firebase cloud service as soon as you choose to continue. We don't sell it or share it with third parties for advertising purposes.

privacy.storageBody: An offline copy stays on your device so the app remains usable without a connection. Your data is also stored in Firebase (Google Cloud) under your Stopklop identifier so you can find it on another device.
privacy.notDoBody: We don't sell your data. We don't share it for advertising purposes. We don't use it outside of running the app.
privacy.rightsBody: You can view, edit or delete your data anytime from the Profile tab, or request full deletion (Profile → Delete my account). EU users have rights of access, rectification, erasure and portability under the GDPR.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.purposeBody: Stopklop is a support and tracking tool to help you quit or reduce smoking. It's not a medical device and does not replace professional medical advice.
terms.healthBody: if you have questions about smoking cessation, your health, or a treatment, consult a doctor or qualified health professional.
terms.accountBody: A Stopklop identifier is created when you start using the app. You can then choose Google or Apple to secure and recover your data across devices. See the privacy policy for details on data processed.
subscriptionItems: The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled before the end of the current period.
Payment is charged to your App Store or Google Play account.
You can cancel anytime from your App Store (iOS) or Google Play (Android) subscription settings — Stopklop cannot cancel it on your behalf.
Deleting your account or uninstalling the app does not automatically cancel an active subscription.
terms.useBody: You agree to use the app in compliance with applicable laws and not to attempt to disrupt its operation or access other users' data.
terms.terminationBody: You can stop using the app and delete your account anytime from Profile → Delete my account.
terms.changesBody: These terms may change; the update date at the top of this page reflects the latest version in effect.
